node: Defense prime contractors and program integrators
summary: Expanded the universe around defense primes as procurement-spec gatekeepers, not as the main alpha pool. The reference lane keeps Lockheed Martin as an anchor because primes convert appropriations into programs and set qualification requirements. The underfollowed lane emphasizes scarce lower-tier suppliers exposed to prime outsourcing, mission-critical electronics, engineered aerostructures, and regulated/strategic materials where small suppliers may face higher administrative burden from tariffs, exemptions, qualification, and supply-chain visibility gaps.
